attorneys: Earl B. Dickerson, Arthur D. Shores and John J. Abt for petitioner. Thomas E. Huey, Jr. for respondent. Thurgood Marshall filed a brief for the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People, as amicus curiae, supporting the petition.

opinions.text:
Supreme Court of Alabama. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion the petition should be granted.
